lines.zh: 我听着蛋壳里细小的动静。
lines.en: I listen to the tiny stirrings inside the eggs.

lines.zh: 一千五百点生命，慢慢耗。
lines.en: Fifteen hundred health. Wear it down slowly.

lines.zh: 第六层的蜂巢还很安静。
lines.en: The hive on the second floor is still quiet.
I count the gaps between dripping honey.
My antennae test the warmth of the hive wall.
The eggs in the hive keep twitching.
Starts moving when seeing the player

lines.zh: 你的脚步惊动了孵卵的蜂兵。
lines.en: Your steps have roused the brooding soldiers.
One egg twitches, and the whole hive wakes.
Every egg in the hive waits on me.

lines.zh: 蜂巢里每八秒就多一个兵。
lines.en: Every eight seconds another soldier hatches.
My drone brood is already hatching.

lines.zh: 我在第六层的暗处盯着你。
lines.en: I watch you from the dark of the sixth floor.
A stranger, and still standing here.
My swarm isn't here yet. I'll endure.
Abdomen is cut; blood won't stop.
The hive wax is cut open; it feels cold.

lines.zh: 你手里的蜜，引不动我的兵。
lines.en: The honey in your hand won't stir my soldiers.
Stay away from me, death awaits!

lines.zh: 不要动我，否则你会遭殃！

lines.en: Are you here to tempt me?

lines.zh: 你离我远点，否则你会死！
lines.en: Stay away from me or die!

lines.zh: 蜂卵里的力量，没人拿得走。
lines.en: The power in my hive egg, no one takes it.

lines.zh: 你踩上了我巢下的蜜渍。
lines.en: You've stepped in the honey beneath my hive.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞上了我的腹节。

lines.en: My name is written in that egg.
I won’t let you touch me!

lines.zh: 离我远点，否则你会挨揍！

lines.en: You can’t get close to me!
Coming near me will cause trouble!

lines.zh: 我是你的女王，你的伴侣！
lines.en: I am your queen, your mate!

lines.zh: 整座蜂巢都由我挑选配偶。
lines.en: The whole hive lets me choose my mate.

lines.zh: 与我共生，你将更加强大！
lines.en: Be with me, and you’ll be stronger!

lines.zh: 成为我的伴侣，享受力量！
lines.en: Be my mate and gain power!

lines.zh: 我是蜂巢的女王，你的伴侣！
lines.en: I am the queen of the hive, your mate!

lines.zh: 我将是你生命中的伴侣！
lines.en: I will be your life mate!

lines.zh: 成为我的伴侣，一起战斗！
lines.en: Be my mate and fight together!

lines.zh: 我是蜂后，你的唯一伴侣！
lines.en: I am the Hive Queen, your only mate!

lines.zh: 成为我的伴侣，共享力量！
lines.en: Be my mate and share power!

lines.zh: 采光触须轻颤，金粉洒落，蜂蜜香气四溢。
lines.en: Gleaming antennae tremble, golden dust falls, honey scent spreads.

lines.zh: 嗡嗡声中，皇后蜂巢散发出耀眼的光芒。
lines.en: Buzzing, the Hive Queen radiates dazzling light.

lines.zh: 金色鳞片闪烁，触须轻拂，蜂蜜滴落。
lines.en: Gold scales shimmer, antennae brush, honey drips.

lines.zh: 触须探向玩家，金银花香气袭来。
lines.en: Antennae reach out, jasmine scent follows.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻颤，金色鳞片在阳光下闪耀。
lines.en: Wings tremble, gold scales gleam in sunlight.

lines.zh: 触须轻轻触碰，甜蜜之吻。
lines.en: Antennae gently touch, a sweet kiss.

lines.zh: 金色触须围绕，蜂蜜香气浓郁。
lines.en: Golden antennae surround, honey scent strong.

lines.zh: 金色触须轻拂，带来蜂蜜的馈赠。
触须轻轻触碰，留下蜂蜜痕迹。
警戒范围激活，翅膀振动。
视野内出现玩家，翅膀快速振动。
触须紧绷，准备迎接入侵者。
翅膀震动，蜂巢皇后准备出击。
触须锁定目标，翅膀展开。
翅膀振动加剧，蜂巢皇后进入战斗状态。
lines.en: Wings vibrate more, Hive Queen enters battle.

lines.zh: 触须锁定玩家，翅膀振动。
翅膀振动，蜂巢皇后发现目标。
lines.en: Wings vibrate, Hive Queen finds target.

lines.zh: 触须锁定，翅膀振动，准备召唤。
lines.en: Antennae lock, wings vibrate, ready to summon.

lines.zh: 翅膀振动，蜂巢皇后开始追踪玩家。
lines.en: Wings vibrate, Hive Queen tracks player.
You stepped inside my alert ring.

lines.zh: 创造模式也挡不住我召。
lines.en: Creative mode won't stop my summons.
The first hive soldier has left the comb.

lines.zh: 你身上有金银花的味道。
lines.en: You carry the smell of honeysuckle.
The hive gate shuts. You stay inside.
This floor belongs to my children.

lines.zh: 以玩家为中心，召唤蜂兵。
以玩家为中心，释放毒刺。
翅膀振动，蜂巢皇后开始集结。
翅膀振动，开始召唤蜂兵。
翅膀振动，蜂巢皇后准备召唤。
以玩家为中心，释放蜂兵。
围绕玩家，开始召唤毒刺。
翅膀振动，蜂巢皇后召唤蜂兵。
翅膀振动，开始集结蜂兵。

lines.en: One every four seconds. Can you keep count?
A soldier every eight seconds, without pause.

lines.zh: 我的孩子会先磨掉你的刀。
lines.en: My children will dull your blade first.
Stingers come up by your feet.

lines.zh: 你砍我一下，巢里多十只。
lines.en: One cut on me, ten more in the comb.
The swarm builds a golden wall.
I wait. My children do the work.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，包围就紧一步。
lines.en: Every step back tightens the ring.
Nightmare honey tastes sweet and bitter.
The hive wall shakes. They are crawling.

lines.zh: 挥舞着巨大的毒刺，向你发起攻击！
lines.en: Swinging its massive stinger to attack!

lines.zh: 嗡嗡作响，释放毒液攻击！
用致命的毒刺穿透你的防护！
lines.en: Piercing your armor with its deadly stinger!

lines.zh: 毒刺闪耀着致命的光芒！
lines.en: Its stinger glows with deadly light!

lines.zh: 释放毒液，让你陷入困境！
攻击前，它释放一簇毒刺！
lines.en: Releases a cluster of stingers before attacking!
Ends your life with its stinger!

lines.zh: 毒刺刺穿防护，注入毒液！

lines.en: Twenty damage is no small thing.
The stinger finds the gap in your armor.
I strike, and the swarm follows.
This sting will push you back three steps.

lines.zh: 警戒范围内，怪物源源不断！
蜂巢皇后开始召唤怪物！
蜂巢皇后开始召唤蜂兵！
怪物源源不断，蜂巢皇后不眠不休！
蜂巢皇后召唤蜂巢守护者！
lines.en: Hive Queen summons a Hive Guard!

lines.zh: 蜂巢皇后持续召唤怪物！
蜂巢皇后不断召唤蜂兵！

lines.en: Right-click the hive egg and I wake.
Nightmare layer two, the hive opens.
One hum, and the queen leaves the comb.
Bring a better blade next time.
You may not tread in my hive.
The honeysuckle blooms, and I wake.
The hive is all wingbeat and echo.
You are standing at the edge of the honey pool.
The swarm comes first. The queen comes after.
This floor has a ruler from today.
Fire curled the edges of my wings.
